checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Severity does not match impact: the review marks task 5.5 ❌ and R1's Impact says "task 5.5's acceptance ('score ≥ 95% (minimum 90%)') is not met" (useUpdateRecheckOnReturn.ts at 87.50%), but tasks.md:40 has '- [x] 5.5 Mutation: … score ≥ 95% (minimum 90%) (M6).' ticked. This is a ticked-but-undone task, which the acceptance criteria name as a CRITICAL case ('CRITICAL only for … a ticked-but-undone task'), yet R1 is a WARNING and the Summary shows CRITICAL 0. R1 should be CRITICAL, or the review should explicitly require un-ticking 5.5 until the fix lands.

Verdict is inconsistent with the findings: 'Ready. No CRITICAL findings' while the review itself reports a ticked task (5.5) whose acceptance is unmet and leaves M6 at ⚠️. The verdict should be not ready until R1 is fixed and useUpdateRecheckOnReturn.ts is re-measured at ≥ 90%.
